description: Export matching people to a CSV job. Costs 1 db_credit per row delivered (admin keys are not charged). Call kanta_db_count first, then set confirm_credits to the number of credits you intend to spend (normally equal to max). Poll the job with kanta_db_export_status, or pass "output" to wait and save the CSV locally in one call (kanta_db_export_download saves a finished export).

confirm_credits.description: credits you authorize spending; must equal the API-computed estimated_max

filter.description: Kanta DB person filter. Keys: query (free text), seniority[] (C-Suite, VP, Director, Manager, …), function[], title, title_exact[], person_country[], person_state[], company, company_domain[], industry[], employee_range[] (e.g. "51-199"), has_email, has_linkedin, has_phone. verification_status[] (valid, catch_all, risky, unknown, invalid). All list keys accept a bare string too. industry takes industry names case-insensitively (e.g. "Software Development", "software") and includes sub-industries; kanta_db_industries lists them. person_country (aliases like "USA", "UK"), person_state (abbreviations like "CA", "ON") and function match case-insensitively; a function also matches people listed under several functions. employee_range takes size bands: 1-10, 11-50, 51-199, 200-499, 500-999, 1000-4999, 5000-9999, 10000-49999, 50000+, Unknown (by headcount where known). Unknown values return suggestions. title_exact matches exactly.

output.description: wait for the export, then save the CSV to this local path

name: kanta_db_export
